method: Traditional doubles side-out scoring. Only the serving team scores when it wins a rally. If the receiving team wins, server 1 gives way to server 2 without changing the score; a loss by server 2 causes a side-out and the other team starts with server 1. The game's opening service turn has only one server, represented by server number 2, so the opening call is 0-0-2. The serving team's even score corresponds to the right service court and its odd score to the left. The score call is serving score, receiving score, then server number. Games end at 11, 15 or 21 points with a two-point lead. All state remains in page memory.
